test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the difference between the simple interest and the compound interest payable annually on a sum of Rs. 6,500 at 7% per annum for 3 years. (Correct to two decimal places.)
solution:
**Given:**

Sum money = Rs, 6500

Interest Rate = 7%

Time = 3 years

**Formula used:**

CI - SI = (P× R²)/100² (3 + r/100)

**Calculations:**

D = (6500 × 49)/1002 (3 + 7/100)

D = (65 × 49) /100 × (307/100)

D = Rs. 97.78

**∴ The difference between simple interest and compound interest is Rs. 97.78.**
